title: How enabling two settings tripled our scores on the ARC-AGI-3 benchmark
summary: How two API settings improved GPT-5.6 performance on ARC-AGI-3, boosting scores and efficiency by retaining reasoning and enabling compaction.
body: How two API settings improved GPT-5.6 performance on ARC-AGI-3, boosting scores and efficiency by retaining reasoning and enabling compaction.
summaryZh: OpenAI发文披露，通过启用两项特定的API设置（即保留推理过程与启用压缩功能），成功使GPT-5.6模型在ARC-AGI-3基准测试中的表现实现三倍增长。该技术手段不仅显著提升了基准测试得分，还在效率上带来突破，为开发者在使用前沿大模型处理复杂逻辑推理任务时提供了重要的配置优化经验。
